proposals.name: wk_next_i
proposals.idea: In-week transitions with integer weights: for the session's last 3 distinct prefix items, items that follow them 1 to 3 steps later in any target-week prefix, weighted 6/3/2 by step and by recency, excluding the session's own prefix items.
proposals.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), li AS (SELECT session, item, min(rk) AS rk FROM l WHERE rk <= 3 GROUP BY session, item), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li), occ AS (SELECT s.session, s.seq, s.item FROM sess s JOIN it ON s.item = it.item), nx AS (SELECT o.item AS item, n.item AS item2, sum(CASE d.k WHEN 1 THEN 6 WHEN 2 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) AS w FROM occ o CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) d(k) JOIN sess n ON n.session = o.session AND n.seq = o.seq + d.k WHERE n.item <> o.item GROUP BY o.item, n.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, nx.item2 AS item, sum(nx.w * CASE li.rk WHEN 1 THEN 6 WHEN 2 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) AS score FROM li JOIN nx ON nx.item = li.item GROUP BY li.session, nx.item2), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess p WHERE p.session = sc.session AND p.item = sc.item)), r AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS rn FROM f) SELECT session, item, CAST(score AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM r WHERE rn <= 40;

proposals.name: wk_cobuy
proposals.idea: In-week view-to-buy: for the session's last 5 distinct prefix items, items carted or ordered in other target-week prefixes that contain those items (up to 1000 most recent prefixes per item), integer weighted by recency rank.
proposals.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), li AS (SELECT session, item, min(rk) AS rk FROM l WHERE rk <= 5 GROUP BY session, item), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li), ps0 AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.ts) AS mt FROM sess s JOIN it ON s.item = it.item GROUP BY s.session, s.item), ps AS (SELECT session, item FROM (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY mt DESC, session) AS rn FROM ps0) z WHERE rn <= 1000), bt AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM sess WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), nx AS (SELECT p.item AS item, b.item AS item2, sum(2 + b.o) AS w FROM ps p JOIN bt b ON b.session = p.session AND b.item <> p.item GROUP BY p.item, b.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, nx.item2 AS item, sum(nx.w * (6 - li.rk)) AS score FROM li JOIN nx ON nx.item = li.item GROUP BY li.session, nx.item2), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess p WHERE p.session = sc.session AND p.item = sc.item)), r AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS rn FROM f) SELECT session, item, CAST(score AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM r WHERE rn <= 40;

proposals.name: h_cobuy
proposals.idea: History buy-to-buy: for the session's last 5 distinct prefix items, items carted or ordered together with them in history sessions with 2 to 30 bought items (up to 300 most recent sessions per item), orders weighted higher, integer scores.
proposals.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), li AS (SELECT session, item, min(rk) AS rk FROM l WHERE rk <= 5 GROUP BY session, item), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li), b0 AS (SELECT session, item, max(ts) AS mt, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM hist WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), bs AS (SELECT session FROM b0 GROUP BY session HAVING count(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 30), bb AS (SELECT b0.session, b0.item, b0.mt, b0.o FROM b0 JOIN bs ON b0.session = bs.session), ps AS (SELECT session, item FROM (SELECT bb.session, bb.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY bb.item ORDER BY bb.mt DESC, bb.session) AS rn FROM bb JOIN it ON bb.item = it.item) z WHERE rn <= 300), nx AS (SELECT p.item AS item, y.item AS item2, sum(1 + 2 * y.o) AS w FROM ps p JOIN bb y ON y.session = p.session AND y.item <> p.item GROUP BY p.item, y.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, nx.item2 AS item, sum(nx.w * (6 - li.rk)) AS score FROM li JOIN nx ON nx.item = li.item GROUP BY li.session, nx.item2), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess p WHERE p.session = sc.session AND p.item = sc.item)), r AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS rn FROM f) SELECT session, item, CAST(score AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM r WHERE rn <= 40;

proposals.name: cobuy
proposals.idea: Pairs of items carted or ordered together in the same history session (2 to 30 bought items), counted by distinct sessions with an order count, as a buy-to-buy co-visitation for later cart and order features.
proposals.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM hist WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), bs AS (SELECT session FROM b GROUP BY session HAVING count(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 30), bb AS (SELECT b.session, b.item, b.o FROM b JOIN bs ON b.session = bs.session), p AS (SELECT x.item AS item, y.item AS item2, count(*) AS n, sum(y.o) AS n_o FROM bb x JOIN bb y ON x.session = y.session AND x.item <> y.item GROUP BY x.item, y.item), r AS (SELECT item, item2, n, n_o, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY n DESC, n_o DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS tv_cnt, CAST(n_o AS DOUBLE) AS tv_ord FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;

proposals.name: nextview
proposals.idea: Forward transitions in the last 7 days of history after collapsing consecutive repeats: item2 appearing 1 to 3 steps after item, weighted 1/step, to predict the next viewed item in later features.
proposals.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT session, item, seq, lag(item) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq, item) AS pi FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400), d AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq, item) AS r FROM e WHERE pi IS NULL OR pi <> item), p AS (SELECT x.item AS item, y.item AS item2, sum(1.0 / k.k) AS w FROM d x CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) k(k) JOIN d y ON y.session = x.session AND y.r = x.r + k.k WHERE y.item <> x.item GROUP BY x.item, y.item), r AS (SELECT item, item2, w, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY w DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, CAST(w AS DOUBLE) AS tv_wgt FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;

proposals.name: nv_pair
proposals.idea: History next-view transition strength from the session's last 3 distinct prefix items to every candidate, including base candidates, using integer weights 3/2/1 by recency. The score is paired with its rank within the session, to sharpen view recall and the ordering of history items.
proposals.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), li AS (SELECT session, item, min(rk) AS rk FROM l GROUP BY session, item), lr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY rk, item) AS r FROM li), lt AS (SELECT session, item, r FROM lr WHERE r <= 3), sc AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, sum(CAST(round(t.tv_wgt * 6) AS BIGINT) * (4 - lt.r)) AS v FROM cand c JOIN lt ON lt.session = c.session JOIN tb_nextview t ON t.item = lt.item AND t.item2 = c.item GROUP BY c.session, c.item), rr AS (SELECT session, item, v, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY v DESC, item) AS rn FROM sc) SELECT session, item, CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_nv_score, CAST(rn AS DOUBLE) AS ag_nv_rank FROM rr;

proposals.name: cb_pair
proposals.idea: Buy-to-buy co-occurrence strength from the session's last 10 distinct prefix items to every candidate, with prefix items that were carted or ordered weighted 3x, plus the number of prefix items that link to the candidate, aimed at cart and order recall.
proposals.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls, max(CASE WHEN s.event IN ('cart', 'order') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b FROM sess s JOIN sessions x ON s.session = x.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, b, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS r FROM p), pt AS (SELECT session, item, b FROM pr WHERE r <= 10), sc AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, sum(CAST(t.tv_cnt AS BIGINT) * (1 + 2 * pt.b)) AS v, count(*) AS n FROM cand c JOIN pt ON pt.session = c.session JOIN tb_cobuy t ON t.item = pt.item AND t.item2 = c.item GROUP BY c.session, c.item) SELECT session, item, CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_cb_score, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS ag_cb_nsrc FROM sc;

proposals.name: p_dwell
proposals.idea: Engagement with each prefix item: the total dwell time in seconds (time to the next prefix event, capped at 300 per event) and the number of separate visits (non-consecutive runs), which are signals of purchase intent that the existing event counts miss.
proposals.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, s.ts, lead(s.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq, s.item) AS nt, lag(s.item) OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq, s.item) AS pi FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), g AS (SELECT session, item, sum(least(nt - ts, 300)) AS dw, sum(CASE WHEN pi IS NULL OR pi <> item THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vis FROM e GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(g.dw AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_dwell, CAST(g.vis AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_visits FROM cand c JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item;

proposals.name: i_conv_hist
proposals.idea: Smoothed item conversion rates over the last 14 days of history, measured as distinct sessions: view to cart and cart to order. These separate items that people browse from items that people buy, and the ratios stay stable across history depths.
proposals.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT DISTINCT session, item, event FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 14*86400), a AS (SELECT item, sum(CASE WHEN event = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS v, sum(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c, sum(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM d GROUP BY item) SELECT item, CAST((c + 1.0) / (v + 20.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_v2c, CAST((o + 1.0) / (c + 5.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_c2o FROM a;

proposals.name: i_trend_wk
proposals.idea: Freshness of each item: the number of distinct target-week prefixes that contain it, relative to its distinct history sessions in the 7 days before, plus the smoothed in-week share of those prefixes that carted or ordered it.
proposals.sql: WITH w AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS ws, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event IN ('cart', 'order') THEN session END) AS wb FROM sess GROUP BY item), h AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS hs FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400 GROUP BY item) SELECT w.item, CAST((w.ws + 1.0) / (coalesce(h.hs, 0) + 10.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_trend, CAST((w.wb + 1.0) / (w.ws + 20.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_wk_buyrate FROM w LEFT JOIN h ON h.item = w.item;

proposals.name: wk_revisit
proposals.idea: In-week transition strength from the session's last 3 distinct prefix items into the candidates that are themselves prefix items (the revisit case, which the in-week source excludes), computed over all target-week prefixes, as a raw score and as a share of all outgoing in-week transitions of those items.
proposals.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), lr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS r FROM l), lt AS (SELECT session, item, r FROM lr WHERE r <= 3), ci AS (SELECT c.session, c.item FROM cand c JOIN l ON l.session = c.session AND l.item = c.item), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), occ AS (SELECT s.session, s.seq, s.item FROM sess s JOIN it ON s.item = it.item), nx AS (SELECT o.item AS item, n.item AS item2, sum(CASE d.k WHEN 1 THEN 4 WHEN 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS w FROM occ o CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) d(k) JOIN sess n ON n.session = o.session AND n.seq = o.seq + d.k WHERE n.item <> o.item GROUP BY o.item, n.item), tot AS (SELECT lt.session, sum(nx.w * (4 - lt.r)) AS t FROM lt JOIN nx ON nx.item = lt.item GROUP BY lt.session), sc AS (SELECT ci.session, ci.item, sum(nx.w * (4 - lt.r)) AS v FROM ci JOIN lt ON lt.session = ci.session JOIN nx ON nx.item = lt.item AND nx.item2 = ci.item GROUP BY ci.session, ci.item) SELECT sc.session, sc.item, CAST(sc.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_wrv_score, CAST(sc.v * 1.0 / tot.t AS DOUBLE) AS ag_wrv_share FROM sc JOIN tot ON tot.session = sc.session;

proposals.name: p_cart_state
proposals.idea: Cart state of each prefix item: seconds from its last cart event to the prefix end, its rank among the prefix's carted items by recency of carting, and whether it was already ordered after that last cart, since an open recent cart is the main source of order labels.
proposals.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, s.seq, s.ts, s.event FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), m AS (SELECT session, max(ts) AS mt FROM e GROUP BY session), c AS (SELECT session, item, max(ts) AS ct, max(seq) AS cs FROM e WHERE event = 'cart' GROUP BY session, item), o AS (SELECT session, item, max(seq) AS os FROM e WHERE event = 'order' GROUP BY session, item), cr AS (SELECT session, item, ct, cs, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY cs DESC, item) AS r FROM c) SELECT cd.session, cd.item, CAST(m.mt - cr.ct AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_cart_age, CAST(cr.r AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_cart_rank, CAST(CASE WHEN o.os IS NOT NULL AND o.os > cr.cs THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_cart_done FROM cand cd JOIN cr ON cr.session = cd.session AND cr.item = cd.item JOIN m ON m.session = cd.session LEFT JOIN o ON o.session = cd.session AND o.item = cd.item;

proposals.name: cb_buy_ord
proposals.idea: Order-oriented complements: from the session's last 10 carted or ordered prefix items only, the summed history co-order count (tv_ord) to each candidate and its smoothed share of the co-buy count, to separate items that are completed into orders from items only co-carted.
proposals.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions x ON s.session = x.session WHERE s.event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS r FROM p), pt AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE r <= 10), sc AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, sum(t.tv_ord) AS v, sum(t.tv_cnt) AS n FROM cand c JOIN pt ON pt.session = c.session JOIN tb_cobuy t ON t.item = pt.item AND t.item2 = c.item GROUP BY c.session, c.item) SELECT session, item, CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_cbb_ord, CAST((v + 0.5) / (n + 2.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_cbb_ord_share FROM sc;

proposals.name: i_revisit
proposals.idea: Item revisit propensity: the smoothed share of 7-day history sessions viewing the item in which it is viewed again after viewing something else, plus the smoothed in-week cart-to-order rate by distinct prefixes, to tell which history items get returned to and which carts get completed.
proposals.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT session, item, seq, lag(item) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq, item) AS pi FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400 AND event = 'view'), g AS (SELECT session, item, sum(CASE WHEN pi IS NULL OR pi <> item THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS runs FROM e GROUP BY session, item), a AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS ns, sum(CASE WHEN runs >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nr FROM g GROUP BY item), w AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN session END) AS c, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN session END) AS o FROM sess WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY item) SELECT a.item, CAST((a.nr + 1.0) / (a.ns + 10.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_revisit, CAST((coalesce(w.o, 0) + 1.0) / (coalesce(w.c, 0) + 5.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_wk_c2o FROM a LEFT JOIN w ON w.item = a.item;

proposals.name: view2buy
proposals.idea: Directed history pairs where an item first viewed earlier in a session (sessions with up to 40 viewed items) is followed by a different item carted or ordered later in it, counted by sessions with an order count, for a later view-to-purchase pair feature.
proposals.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT session, item, min(seq) AS cs, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM hist WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), css AS (SELECT DISTINCT session FROM c), v AS (SELECT h.session, h.item, min(h.seq) AS fs FROM hist h JOIN css ON h.session = css.session WHERE h.event = 'view' GROUP BY h.session, h.item), vn AS (SELECT session FROM v GROUP BY session HAVING count(*) <= 40), p AS (SELECT x.item AS item, c.item AS item2, count(*) AS n, sum(c.o) AS n_o FROM v x JOIN vn ON x.session = vn.session JOIN c ON c.session = x.session AND x.fs < c.cs AND x.item <> c.item GROUP BY x.item, c.item), r AS (SELECT item, item2, n, n_o, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY n DESC, n_o DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS tv_cnt, CAST(n_o AS DOUBLE) AS tv_ord FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;

proposals.name: v2b_pair
proposals.idea: History view-to-purchase strength from the session's last 10 distinct prefix items to every candidate via tb_view2buy, weighted 10..1 by recency, plus the smoothed order share of those links, to lift cart and order items that browsing leads to.
proposals.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions x ON s.session = x.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS r FROM p), pt AS (SELECT session, item, r FROM pr WHERE r <= 10), sc AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, sum(CAST(t.tv_cnt AS BIGINT) * (11 - pt.r)) AS v, sum(CAST(t.tv_cnt AS BIGINT)) AS n, sum(CAST(t.tv_ord AS BIGINT)) AS o FROM cand c JOIN pt ON pt.session = c.session AND pt.item <> c.item JOIN tb_view2buy t ON t.item = pt.item AND t.item2 = c.item GROUP BY c.session, c.item) SELECT session, item, CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_v2b_score, CAST((o + 0.5) / (n + 2.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_v2b_ord_share FROM sc;

proposals.name: wk_cobuy_all
proposals.idea: In-week co-buy share for all candidates including base ones: for the last 5 distinct prefix items, the share of other recent target-week prefixes containing them that carted or ordered the candidate (own prefix removed), recency weighted, plus the order count.
proposals.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), lr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS r FROM l), lt AS (SELECT session, item, r FROM lr WHERE r <= 5), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), bt AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM sess WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), ps0 AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.ts) AS mt FROM sess s JOIN it ON s.item = it.item GROUP BY s.session, s.item), ps AS (SELECT session, item FROM (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY mt DESC, session) AS rn FROM ps0) z WHERE rn <= 1000), nn AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n FROM ps GROUP BY item), nx AS (SELECT p.item AS item, b.item AS item2, count(*) AS nb, sum(b.o) AS nord FROM ps p JOIN bt b ON b.session = p.session AND b.item <> p.item GROUP BY p.item, b.item), z0 AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, lt.r, nn.n, nx.nb - CASE WHEN ob.item IS NOT NULL AND op.item IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS nb, nx.nord - CASE WHEN ob.item IS NOT NULL AND op.item IS NOT NULL THEN ob.o ELSE 0 END AS nord FROM cand c JOIN lt ON lt.session = c.session AND lt.item <> c.item JOIN nx ON nx.item = lt.item AND nx.item2 = c.item JOIN nn ON nn.item = lt.item LEFT JOIN bt ob ON ob.session = c.session AND ob.item = c.item LEFT JOIN ps op ON op.session = c.session AND op.item = lt.item), sc AS (SELECT session, item, sum((nb * 100000) // (n + 5) * (6 - r)) AS v, sum(nord * (6 - r)) AS vo FROM z0 WHERE nb > 0 GROUP BY session, item) SELECT session, item, CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_wcb_share, CAST(vo AS DOUBLE) AS ag_wcb_ord FROM sc WHERE v > 0;

proposals.name: nv_last_share
proposals.idea: Normalized history next-view probability from the very last prefix item to the candidate (its transition weight divided by the total outgoing weight of that item), a sharper signal for the first viewed item after the cut.
proposals.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), li AS (SELECT session, item FROM e WHERE rk = 1), tw AS (SELECT t.item, t.item2, CAST(round(t.tv_wgt * 6) AS BIGINT) AS w FROM tb_nextview t JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li) u ON u.item = t.item), tt AS (SELECT item, sum(w) AS tot FROM tw GROUP BY item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(tw.w * 1.0 / tt.tot AS DOUBLE) AS ag_nv1_share FROM cand c JOIN li ON li.session = c.session JOIN tw ON tw.item = li.item AND tw.item2 = c.item JOIN tt ON tt.item = li.item WHERE tt.tot > 0;

proposals.name: i_buy_momentum
proposals.idea: Purchase momentum of each item: smoothed share of its 7-day history buying sessions that fall in the last day before the week, and in-week buying prefixes relative to those 7-day history buying sessions, to catch items whose sales are rising now.
proposals.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ts >= {S} - 86400 THEN session END) AS c1, count(DISTINCT session) AS c7 FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400 AND event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY item), w AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS wc FROM sess WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY item), u AS (SELECT item FROM h UNION SELECT item FROM w) SELECT u.item, CAST((coalesce(h.c1, 0) + 1.0) / (coalesce(h.c7, 0) + 7.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_buy_mom, CAST((coalesce(w.wc, 0) + 1.0) / (coalesce(h.c7, 0) + 5.0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_wk_buy_trend FROM u LEFT JOIN h ON h.item = u.item LEFT JOIN w ON w.item = u.item;

proposals.name: p_span_rel
proposals.idea: Temporal shape of each prefix item: seconds between its first and last occurrence (sustained interest) and its last-occurrence age relative to the session duration, which normalizes recency across fast and slow sessions.
proposals.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, s.ts FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), m AS (SELECT session, max(ts) AS mt, min(ts) AS ft FROM e GROUP BY session), g AS (SELECT session, item, min(ts) AS f, max(ts) AS l FROM e GROUP BY session, item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(g.l - g.f AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_span, CAST((m.mt - g.l) * 1.0 / (m.mt - m.ft + 60) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_age_rel FROM cand c JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item JOIN m ON m.session = c.session;

proposals.name: p_self_trans
proposals.idea: Within-session transitions involving the last prefix item: how often the candidate directly followed the last item earlier in this prefix and how often it directly preceded it, capturing back-and-forth comparison between two items that predicts the next view.
proposals.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, s.seq, lag(s.item) OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq, s.item) AS pi, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item DESC) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions x ON s.session = x.session), li AS (SELECT session, item AS li FROM e WHERE rk = 1), fa AS (SELECT e.session, e.item, count(*) AS n FROM e JOIN li ON li.session = e.session WHERE e.pi = li.li AND e.item <> li.li GROUP BY e.session, e.item), tb AS (SELECT e.session, e.pi AS item, count(*) AS n FROM e JOIN li ON li.session = e.session WHERE e.item = li.li AND e.pi <> li.li AND e.rk > 1 GROUP BY e.session, e.pi), u AS (SELECT session, item FROM fa UNION SELECT session, item FROM tb) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(coalesce(fa.n, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_after_last, CAST(coalesce(tb.n, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_p_before_last FROM cand c JOIN u ON u.session = c.session AND u.item = c.item LEFT JOIN fa ON fa.session = c.session AND fa.item = c.item LEFT JOIN tb ON tb.session = c.session AND tb.item = c.item;

proposals.name: nv_backward
proposals.idea: Reverse history next-view strength: how strongly the candidate leads into the session's last 3 distinct prefix items (weighted 3/2/1), which identifies substitutes and alternatives of the browsed items that forward transitions miss.
proposals.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), lr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS r FROM l), lt AS (SELECT session, item, r FROM lr WHERE r <= 3), sc AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, sum(CAST(round(t.tv_wgt * 6) AS BIGINT) * (4 - lt.r)) AS v FROM cand c JOIN lt ON lt.session = c.session AND lt.item <> c.item JOIN tb_nextview t ON t.item = c.item AND t.item2 = lt.item GROUP BY c.session, c.item) SELECT session, item, CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_nvb_score FROM sc WHERE v > 0;

proposals.name: wk_cocart
proposals.idea: In-week cart-to-cart affinity: for the session's last 5 carted or ordered prefix items, the share of other recent target-week prefixes buying those items that also carted or ordered the candidate (own prefix removed), recency weighted, aimed at cart and order completion.
proposals.sql: WITH bt AS (SELECT session, item, max(ts) AS mt, max(seq) AS ls FROM sess WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), lr AS (SELECT bt.session, bt.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY bt.session ORDER BY bt.ls DESC, bt.item) AS r FROM bt JOIN sessions b ON b.session = bt.session), lt AS (SELECT session, item, r FROM lr WHERE r <= 5), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), ps AS (SELECT session, item FROM (SELECT bt.session, bt.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY bt.item ORDER BY bt.mt DESC, bt.session) AS rn FROM bt JOIN it ON bt.item = it.item) z WHERE rn <= 1000), nn AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n FROM ps GROUP BY item), nx AS (SELECT p.item AS item, b.item AS item2, count(*) AS nb FROM ps p JOIN bt b ON b.session = p.session AND b.item <> p.item GROUP BY p.item, b.item), z0 AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, lt.r, nn.n, nx.nb - CASE WHEN ob.item IS NOT NULL AND op.item IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS nb FROM cand c JOIN lt ON lt.session = c.session AND lt.item <> c.item JOIN nx ON nx.item = lt.item AND nx.item2 = c.item JOIN nn ON nn.item = lt.item LEFT JOIN bt ob ON ob.session = c.session AND ob.item = c.item LEFT JOIN ps op ON op.session = c.session AND op.item = lt.item), sc AS (SELECT session, item, sum((nb * 100000) // (n + 5) * (6 - r)) AS v FROM z0 WHERE nb > 0 GROUP BY session, item) SELECT session, item, CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_wcc_share FROM sc WHERE v > 0;

proposals.name: wk_coview_last
proposals.idea: In-week whole-prefix co-visitation from the very last prefix item: the share of the 300 most recent other target-week prefixes containing it that also contain the candidate (own prefix removed), covering base and history candidates beyond 1-3 step transitions.
proposals.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), lt AS (SELECT session, item FROM l WHERE rk = 1), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), ps0 AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.ts) AS mt FROM sess s JOIN it ON s.item = it.item GROUP BY s.session, s.item), ps AS (SELECT session, item FROM (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY mt DESC, session) AS rn FROM ps0) z WHERE rn <= 300), nn AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n FROM ps GROUP BY item), si AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.session, s.item FROM sess s JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT session FROM ps) q ON q.session = s.session), nx AS (SELECT p.item AS item, y.item AS item2, count(*) AS nb FROM ps p JOIN si y ON y.session = p.session AND y.item <> p.item GROUP BY p.item, y.item), oc AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.session, s.item FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), z0 AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, nn.n, nx.nb - CASE WHEN op.item IS NOT NULL AND oc.item IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS nb FROM cand c JOIN lt ON lt.session = c.session AND lt.item <> c.item JOIN nx ON nx.item = lt.item AND nx.item2 = c.item JOIN nn ON nn.item = lt.item LEFT JOIN ps op ON op.session = c.session AND op.item = lt.item LEFT JOIN oc ON oc.session = c.session AND oc.item = c.item) SELECT session, item, CAST((nb + 0.0) / (n + 5) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_wcv_share FROM z0 WHERE nb > 0;
